title: OS command injection via execSync
attack_path: Unauthenticated req.query.host is concatenated into a shell command. /ping?host=127.0.0.1;id runs arbitrary commands as the node process user and reflects output.
fix: Use execFileSync('ping', ['-c','1', host]) (no shell), and validate host against a strict IP/hostname pattern first.
verifier_notes: Each hop connects: the entry point reads attacker input and it reaches the sink with no validation anywhere along the bundle.
validation_steps: Trigger the route with the class-typical probe (a quote, a metacharacter, or a traversal sequence) and observe the unsafe behavior in the response or on the host.

title: SQL injection via string concatenation across files
evidence: const sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'"; return conn.query(sql);
attack_path: Unauthenticated req.query.name crosses the module boundary into db.findUsers and lands in the SQL string unescaped. /users?name=' OR '1'='1 dumps the users table.
fix: Parameterized query in db.js (conn.query('SELECT ... WHERE name = ?', [name]) or the driver's equivalent); never concatenate request data into SQL.

title: Remote code execution via eval on request body
attack_path: Unauthenticated req.body.expr is evaluated as JavaScript by eval. Any expression, including require('child_process').execSync(...), executes; this is unauthenticated RCE.
fix: Remove eval entirely. If expression evaluation is a real requirement, use a sandboxed expression parser with an allowlist of operators and no scope access.
verifier_notes: req.body.expr flows directly into eval with no indirection; JSON body parsing is already enabled, so no content-type trickery is needed.
validation_steps: POST {"expr": "1+1"} and observe 2; then with a harmless marker like globalThis.__poc = true.

title: Path traversal in file download
attack_path: Unauthenticated req.query.file is joined into a filesystem path without validation. /download?file=../../../../etc/passwd escapes the files directory; path.join does not protect against .. segments.
fix: Resolve with path.resolve and require the result to start with the files directory, or serve from an allowlist of known filenames.

title: Hardcoded API key in source
attack_path: A live-format API key committed to source is compromised on commit; repo readers and git history both hold it.
fix: Move to environment variables or a secrets manager; rotate the key now.

title: Hardcoded session secret
attack_path: A guessable committed session secret lets attackers forge or tamper with session data in any middleware that uses it.
fix: Load from the environment with a strong random value per environment.
